item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #VISPRSD
Issued at 06:20 AM 05 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Iloilo(BarotacNuevo, Dumangas, Anilao), #Guimaras(Buenavista), #NegrosOccidental(BacolodCity, CityOfTalisay), #Palawan(Balabac and Brooke'sPoint) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NegrosOccidental(SilayCity, EnriqueB.Magalona, CityOfVictorias), #Palawan(Bataraza and Rizal) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
